repos_data.description: A terminal workbench in pure Rust: shells, persistent sessions, SSH, coding agents. GPU-rendered on Zed's gpui, VT core from Alacritty.
A native macOS terminal for running AI coding agents in parallel — built on real libghostty, with persistent tmux-style sessions and a scriptable Lua/CLI control plane.
PiloTY: AI pilot for PTY operations via MCP - enables AI agents to control interactive terminals like a human
Never lose a command's output again — searchable, per-command terminal scrollback recorder
